inputs.text: A continuous cinematic food advertising shot of four thick golden chocolate chip cookies overlapping in a rectangular silver foil tray on a dark wooden table, exactly as in the opening photograph. The camera begins above the tray, slowly glides toward the near end and descends in a shallow arc, revealing the thickness and craggy edges of the front cookie as the farther cookies recede with natural perspective and parallax. A broad warm window reflection travels gently across the foil rim and the baked ridges, drawing attention from the whole tray to the chocolate texture. The cookies and tray remain still. The camera eases to a composed close view in the final second. Soft warm side light, gentle shadow falloff, appetizing realistic texture, restrained lens movement, smooth continuous motion, one unbroken take.
